// Workout Log: log a session as a list of exercises, each with its sets, reps and weight in
// kilograms. Sessions are kept as one JSON list in storage.kv, and the full history stays on the
// first screen. Tapping a past session opens it; the + starts a new one.
import {
  defineApp,
  nav,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Card,
  Divider,
  Grid,
  Text,
  Button,
  TextInput,
  NumberInput,
  DateInput,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  Badge,
  toast,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

// The whole app keeps its rows as one JSON list under one kv key, so the schema declares no
// collections.
const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  collections: {},
};

type SetEntry = { reps: number; weight: number };
type Exercise = { name: string; sets: SetEntry[] };
type Session = { id: number; at: number; exercises: Exercise[] };

// Module-level state: a tiny store the screens subscribe to, so the history repaints the moment a
// session is saved or deleted.
let sessions: Session[] = [];
let opened: Session | null = null;
const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function publish(next: Session[]): void {
  sessions = next;
  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
}

function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

function toSet(value: unknown): SetEntry | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return null;
  const entry = value as { reps?: unknown; weight?: unknown };
  return {
    reps: typeof entry.reps === 'number' ? entry.reps : 0,
    weight: typeof entry.weight === 'number' ? entry.weight : 0,
  };
}

function toExercise(value: unknown): Exercise | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return null;
  const row = value as { name?: unknown; sets?: unknown };
  const sets: SetEntry[] = Array.isArray(row.sets)
    ? row.sets.map(toSet).filter((entry): entry is SetEntry => entry !== null)
    : [];
  return { name: typeof row.name === 'string' ? row.name : 'Exercise', sets };
}

function toSession(value: unknown): Session | null {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return null;
  const row = value as { id?: unknown; at?: unknown; exercises?: unknown };
  const at = typeof row.at === 'number' ? row.at : Date.now();
  const exercises: Exercise[] = Array.isArray(row.exercises)
    ? row.exercises.map(toExercise).filter((exercise): exercise is Exercise => exercise !== null)
    : [];
  return { id: typeof row.id === 'number' ? row.id : at, at, exercises };
}

async function loadSessions(): Promise<void> {
  const raw = await storage.kv.get('sessions');
  const rows: unknown[] = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : [];
  publish(rows.map(toSession).filter((session): session is Session => session !== null));
}

async function saveSessions(next: Session[]): Promise<void> {
  await storage.kv.set('sessions', next);
  publish(next);
}

function formatDay(ms: number): string {
  return new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

function setCount(session: Session): number {
  return session.exercises.reduce((sum, exercise) => sum + exercise.sets.length, 0);
}

function volume(session: Session): number {
  return session.exercises.reduce(
    (sum, exercise) => sum + exercise.sets.reduce((total, entry) => total + entry.reps * entry.weight, 0),
    0,
  );
}

function History() {
  const [list, setList] = useState<Session[]>(sessions);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    const unsubscribe = subscribe(() => setList(sessions));
    loadSessions().catch(() => {
      if (live) toast('Couldn’t load your sessions.');
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const ordered = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
  const totalSets = ordered.reduce((sum, session) => sum + setCount(session), 0);
  const totalVolume = Math.round(ordered.reduce((sum, session) => sum + volume(session), 0));

  return (
    <Screen
      title="Workout Log"
      action={{ icon: 'plus', label: 'Log a session', onPress: () => nav.navigate('LogSession') }}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Card>
          <Row justify="between">
            <Stack gap="none">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Sessions</Text>
              <Text size="title">{String(ordered.length)}</Text>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="none">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Sets</Text>
              <Text size="title">{String(totalSets)}</Text>
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="none">
              <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Total kg</Text>
              <Text size="title">{totalVolume.toLocaleString()}</Text>
            </Stack>
          </Row>
        </Card>

        {ordered.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon="dumbbell" title="No sessions yet" hint="Tap + to log your first workout." />
        ) : (
          <List
            items={ordered}
            keyBy="id"
            renderItem={(session) => (
              <ListItem
                title={formatDay(session.at)}
                subtitle={`${session.exercises.length} exercise${session.exercises.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} · ${setCount(session)} sets`}
                trailing={`${Math.round(volume(session)).toLocaleString()} kg`}
                icon="dumbbell"
                onPress={() => {
                  opened = session;
                  nav.navigate('SessionDetail');
                }}
              />
            )}
          />
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

function SessionDetail() {
  const session = opened;

  const remove = () => {
    if (session === null) return;
    saveSessions(sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== session.id))
      .then(() => {
        toast('Session deleted');
        nav.back();
      })
      .catch(() => toast('Couldn’t delete that session.'));
  };

  if (session === null) {
    return (
      <Screen title="Session">
        <EmptyState icon="clipboard-list" title="Nothing to show" hint="Open a session from your history." />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Screen title={formatDay(session.at)}>
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <Row gap="sm">
          <Badge label={`${session.exercises.length} exercises`} tone="primary" />
          <Text color="text-muted">{`${setCount(session)} sets · ${Math.round(volume(session)).toLocaleString()} kg`}</Text>
        </Row>

        {session.exercises.map((exercise, index) => (
          <Card key={`${exercise.name}-${index}`}>
            <Stack gap="sm">
              <Row justify="between">
                <Text size="subtitle">{exercise.name}</Text>
                <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">{`${exercise.sets.length} sets`}</Text>
              </Row>
              <Divider />
              {exercise.sets.map((entry, position) => (
                <Row key={position} justify="between">
                  <Text color="text-muted">{`Set ${position + 1}`}</Text>
                  <Text>{`${entry.reps} reps · ${entry.weight} kg`}</Text>
                </Row>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          </Card>
        ))}

        <Button label="Delete session" variant="danger" icon="trash-2" onPress={remove} />
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

type DraftSet = { id: number; reps: number; weight: number };
type DraftExercise = { id: number; name: string; sets: SetEntry[] };

let nextDraftId = 1;

function today(): number {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return d.getTime();
}

function LogSession() {
  const [at, setAt] = useState<number | null>(today());
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [reps, setReps] = useState(10);
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState(20);
  const [sets, setSets] = useState<DraftSet[]>([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<DraftExercise[]>([]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const addSet = () => setSets([...sets, { id: nextDraftId++, reps, weight }]);
  const removeSet = (id: number) => setSets(sets.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
  const removeExercise = (id: number) => setDraft(draft.filter((exercise) => exercise.id !== id));

  const addExercise = () => {
    const label = name.trim();
    setDraft([
      ...draft,
      { id: nextDraftId++, name: label, sets: sets.map((entry) => ({ reps: entry.reps, weight: entry.weight })) },
    ]);
    setSets([]);
    setName('');
    toast(`${label} added`);
  };

  const pending: Exercise | null =
    name.trim() !== '' && sets.length > 0
      ? { name: name.trim(), sets: sets.map((entry) => ({ reps: entry.reps, weight: entry.weight })) }
      : null;

  // Anything still on the bench counts as the last exercise of the session when you save.
  const exercises: Exercise[] = (pending ? [...draft, pending] : draft).map((exercise) => ({
    name: exercise.name,
    sets: exercise.sets,
  }));
  const ready = exercises.length > 0;

  const openDraft = (id: number) => {
    const exercise = draft.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
    if (exercise === undefined) return;
    setName(exercise.name);
    setSets(exercise.sets.map((entry) => ({ id: nextDraftId++, reps: entry.reps, weight: entry.weight })));
    setDraft(draft.filter((entry) => entry.id !== id));
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!ready || saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    const session: Session = { id: Date.now(), at: at ?? Date.now(), exercises };
    saveSessions([session, ...sessions])
      .then(() => {
        toast('Session saved');
        nav.back();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setSaving(false);
        toast('Couldn’t save the session. Try again.');
      });
  };

  return (
    <Screen title="Log a session">
      <Stack gap="lg">
        <DateInput label="Date" value={at} onChange={setAt} />

        {draft.length > 0 ? (
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">In this session · tap one to edit it</Text>
            <List
              items={draft}
              keyBy="id"
              renderItem={(exercise) => (
                <ListItem
                  title={exercise.name}
                  subtitle={exercise.sets.map((entry) => `${entry.reps} × ${entry.weight} kg`).join(' · ')}
                  icon="dumbbell"
                  onPress={() => openDraft(exercise.id)}
                />
              )}
            />
          </Stack>
        ) : null}

        <Card>
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <TextInput label="Exercise" value={name} placeholder="Bench press" onChange={setName} />
            <Grid columns={2}>
              <NumberInput label="Reps" value={reps} min={1} max={100} onChange={setReps} />
              <NumberInput label="Weight (kg)" value={weight} min={0} max={500} step={2.5} onChange={setWeight} />
            </Grid>
            <Button label="Add set" variant="secondary" icon="plus" onPress={addSet} />
          </Stack>
        </Card>

        {sets.length > 0 ? (
          <List
            items={sets}
            keyBy="id"
            renderItem={(entry, index) => (
              <ListItem
                title={`Set ${index + 1}`}
                trailing={`${entry.reps} reps · ${entry.weight} kg`}
                onPress={() => removeSet(entry.id)}
              />
            )}
          />
        ) : (
          <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">
            Add a set above, name the exercise, then save the session.
          </Text>
        )}

        <Grid columns={2}>
          <Button
            label="Add exercise"
            variant="secondary"
            icon="check"
            disabled={name.trim() === '' || sets.length === 0}
            onPress={addExercise}
          />
          <Button label="Save session" icon="dumbbell" disabled={!ready || saving} onPress={save} />
        </Grid>
      </Stack>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Workout Log',
  initial: 'History',
  screens: { History, SessionDetail, LogSession },
  capabilities: ['storage'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['indigo', 'violet', 'slate'],
  icon: 'dumbbell',
});
